recipes.name: Congee inspired by Mulan
instructions: In a pressure cooker, combine long grain jasmine rice with chicken stock along with knob of ginger, finely chopped, and garlic finely chopped. Cook on high pressure for 30 minutes. Quick release the pressure, and season with salt and pepper. - 1 cup long grain jasmine rice - 6 cups chicken stock - 1 inch knob of ginger chopped - 1 cloves garlic divided
In a pan with vegetable oil, fry up one shallot that is finely chopped and one clove of finely chopped garlic and let drain on paper towels. - 1 shallot finely chopped - 1 cloves garlic divided
In the same pan, fry up some shiitake mushrooms and set aside. - Shiitake mushrooms
Fry up bacon and set aside. In the same pan, fry sunny side up eggs. - 3 slices bacon - 2 eggs

Add the rice cooked in chicken stock to a bowl and use the bacon and eggs to make a face on top of the rice. Use the shiitake mushrooms for the eyebrows, black sesame seeds for the pupils, the fried garlic and shallots for the hair, the chopped green onion for the beard, some slices of ginger for the ears, a fried piece of garlic for the nose, and sriracha for the acne. (Be creative and use whatever you’d like to make the face!) - Sesame seeds - 1 green onion - Peanuts - Sriracha - Salt - Pepper
